lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct vertical white lines traverse the grey-brown torso. Spacing is irregular, with approximately 120-150 pixels between central lines and closer grouping (approx. 80 pixels) toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is abbreviated, terminating 1/3 down the torso. Lines 3 and 5 exhibit fading/discontinuity before reaching the long ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct white spots are located on the upper haunch near the spinal transition; low density grouping.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the upper hind limb align vertically, roughly parallel to the posterior torso lines.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a posterior spiral trajectory with a lyrate curvature, originating at approximately a 40-degree angle from the skull and curving inward and upward at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.2 times the width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 12% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking across the snout and two distinct white spots vertically aligned on the cheek below the eye.
